### export

- OST export (.ost): Export the selected bid back to an OST file (raw-table serialization with Latin-1 rules). Needed for round trip to desktop. iOS has no writer.
- OSP export (.osp package): Package the bid plus its page images into a CAB-based OSP with safe member paths. iOS can only extract CAB files.
- PDF export with takeoff and annotation markup: Per-page PDF export drawing takeoffs and all annotation types as vector markup over the page, overlay or composite background (or blank), using PDFium and QPDF.
- PDF annotation captions (Bluebeam-compatible): Options > Export lets users choose which measurement captions appear on exported takeoff annotations in the PDF.
- FBX export: Mesh export to FBX through the shared exporter base.
- Summary CSV export: Export the Summary tab (grouped by Area, Type or Page) to CSV with natural/type/page/area sorting and optional condition-name elevation dropping.
- Full-featured HTML 3D export viewer: The Windows HTML export has a 2D plan tab with the PDF and SVG takeoff overlay, page combo, Visibility panel (by Layer, Condition or Area), hover tip with elevations/SF/C ...
- Elevation callouts in HTML and PDF exports: Visibility-aware callouts with condition name, top and bottom elevation (nearest 1/8 in) and cubic yards, each independently toggled, with color options for HTML and PDF.
- Drop condition elevation from names in OST/OSP and CSV exports: Export options that strip the elevation suffix from condition names.

- Separate 2D and 3D takeoff display modes with sync toggle: View > Takeoff: Transparent, Solid or Original for 2D and 3D independently, a Sync 2D/3D toggle, and grayscale. iOS has one color mode for both views.
- Count condition shape meshes (ellipse, triangle, rhombus, hexagon, octagon): Elliptical cylinder with width/depth and triangle, rhombus, hexagon and octagon prisms. iOS builds only box and circular cylinder. [implemented by the fix phase as MSH-08, MSH-09, MSH-10, MSH-11 (fixed)]

### Windows-only changes of job 6 (bf6b8fc and 49a2d59, added 2026-11-21)

These features were changed or added by Windows `bf6b8fc` (cover sheet save, unreachable PDF shares, folder edits after Reload, compact 3D controls) or touch conditions that iOS cannot create; they have no iOS counterpart (grep of Core, Services, Controllers, PlanView and Rendering; nothing was implemented or invented):

- Unreachable PDF shares (`application/utils/path_probe.py`, the plan view bar text "cannot be accessed", the page renderer and the Cover Sheet path checks): iOS treats an unreachable PDF as an absent PDF (`fileExistsAtPath:` never throws, `CGPDFDocumentCreateWithURL` returns NULL), keeps takeoffs and quantities working and has no message bar [outcome-level partial counterpart, no change].
- Cover Sheet save error handling (the dialog stays open with the error, the edit lease is kept): iOS has no Cover Sheet; the bid date is stored as opaque text and never parsed.
- SQL collaboration: `clear_collaboration_conflicts` after the Reload answer (New Folder and folder delete / rename / move work again), the OST text form of date and Decimal values in queued payloads and in the request hash, and `ModalEditLeaseSession` returning the lease on KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit: iOS has one local SQLite file and no synchronisation state.
- Shared OST text rules (`domain/services/ost_text_values.py`: `format_ost_datetime`, `parse_ost_datetime`, `format_ost_decimal`, used by the serializer, the payload encoders and the Access importer): only the parse half of the datetime rule exists on iOS (the import, IMP-20 (1), already matching); iOS cannot write .ost or .osp.
- Compact 3D control row (section cut sliders, Edges, Tower crane: `section_cut_controls.py`, `component_builder.py`, `mesh_view_window.py`) and the tower-crane docstring cleanups: iOS has no such controls (the clip planes of `Core/Domain/CameraLimits.hpp` are the camera near and far planes).
- Condition numbering (`49a2d59`): New Condition, the cross-bid paste of conditions, Duplicate and Reassign Takeoff, the multi-condition Duplicate and Renumber Conditions (two-phase renumbering with temporary numbers) have no iOS counterpart; only the single-condition Duplicate exists and it carries the new guard (DLG-FINITE-01).

The docs were PORTING_STATUS.md, PORTING_MAP.md, PORTING_PLAN.md, PORTING_BLOCKERS.md, PORTING_STATUS.json and PORTING_LOG.md (repo root; there is no docs folder). They have been rewritten since (commit 42b46c3 and the final documentation pass), so do not read this table as a description of the current docs or of the current code: the `Reality` column describes the code as mapped, before the fixes, and the outcome of each referenced item is in sections A-D. Claims reported by several areas are listed once.
